question: Does consuming unzip improve the complete exported CPU reference constructor enough to justify a later complete production Worker RPC study?
candidate: Only KdTree::new final points/indices collection changes from two borrowed scans to one consuming unzip. Median partition, tree, bounds, certificates, all APIs and production runtime stay unchanged.
screenScope: One Dedicated Worker with two independent ordinary stable/SIMD WASM memories. Entire exported GpuC2cReference constructor on parsed LOD-ordered source clouds; free, counters, validation and parsing outside the clock. No GPU, exact distance work, full C2C RPC, load timing, or verification pool in the clock.
orderScheme: Alternate the first mode every warmup/trial pair; reverse first mode on each repeated dataset. Include all pairs and tails. Run reports sequentially without other heavy work.

screenGate.definition: For every report: median(unzip/baseline constructor milliseconds) <=0.97, at least 8/12 unzip-faster pairs, and maximum(unzip/baseline committed WASM linear memory bytes) <=1.02. Linear memory is not live/peak heap. Any failure rejects production adoption and discards the conditional RPC budget.

conditionalRpc.scope: Matched separately built ordinary production Workers with only the measured Rust collection change. Full cold and cached C2C RPC including tree/export/upload/exact verification/statistics/f32 response; parsing excluded; device/pipeline warm. No phase probe, diagnostics, alternative traversal/upload modes or GPU timestamps.

correctness: Before and after timings: identical exact tree snapshots, GPU point/node exports, exact full query export, all full f64 distances and displayed f32 bytes across variants. Check independent query export ownership, released reference wrapper, 12 hint/bounds/SIMD combinations, range rejection and full object release. Existing bounded native correctness protocol remains closed.
safety: No new toolchains/downloads, GPU adapter request, hardware identity, previous budget extension or production source mutation. Keep the same real canonical even/odd subsets and retain every timing report. Screen failures do not establish application-level performance.
